title: Summer Satay Velvety Soup
description: A refreshing summer soup inspired by the flavors of Southeast Asia, blending the creaminess of velvety and the warmth of satay.

ingredients.name: Summer squash
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini or yellow crookneck

instructions: Heat the velvety in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the summer squash and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the savory vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the satay sauce and coconut cream (if using).
Reduce heat to low and let soup simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed.
Stir in chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
